summary: Iteration 37 — Backend-only verification of (1) new GET /api/products/master/deodap-detail endpoint, (2) `handle` field on Deodap rows in /products/master/search, and (3) 91mobiles thumbnail→big URL rewrite. 10/11 tests PASS. FAIL: TestM91ThumbRewrite — the 91mobiles thumb→big rewrite guard in _shape_91_row uses AND when it should be OR. Actual 91mobiles autosuggest URLs look like `https://www.91-img.com/pictures/148763-v4-apple-iphone-15-mobile-phone-thumb-1.jpg` (contains `-thumb-` but does NOT contain `/thumb/`), so the current guard `if thumb and '/thumb/' in thumb and '-thumb-' in thumb:` never fires and no URLs are rewritten. All 9 iPhone-15 variants still ship the blurry `-thumb-1.jpg` variant to the client. Deodap-detail endpoint fully verified: 401 unauth, 200 with 5-12 HD https:// cdn.shopify.com images for valid handles (tested with wireless-over-ear-bluetooth-headphones-zw-053 + live-search-derived handles), 404 clean error for junk handle, 422 for missing param. Deodap rows in search now carry non-empty `handle` field usable end-to-end for the on-pick gallery enrichment. All regressions PASS: vendor POST /products with serial+imei_1+imei_2 persists, /shop-layout returns items, /products/master/91mobiles-specs works for iPhone 15, /products/master/search merges 3 sources (local + 91mobiles + deodap). NOTE: I cleared 10 stale entries from `products_master_cache` collection during testing — the previous cache contained pre-`handle`-field Deodap rows that would have masked the new field. Consider a one-shot cache purge on deploy.

critical.issue: 91mobiles thumb→big URL rewrite in _shape_91_row is broken. In /app/backend/routes/products_master.py:162 the guard is `if thumb and '/thumb/' in thumb and '-thumb-' in thumb:` — this uses AND, but real 91mobiles autosuggest URLs (e.g. `https://www.91-img.com/pictures/148763-v4-apple-iphone-15-mobile-phone-thumb-1.jpg`) contain `-thumb-` only, NOT `/thumb/`. The AND causes the rewrite to be skipped for every 91mobiles URL observed in production. Fix: change AND to OR: `if thumb and ('/thumb/' in thumb or '-thumb-' in thumb):`. The two .replace() calls below are already idempotent so no other change needed. All 9 iPhone-15 variant thumbnails ship as `-thumb-1.jpg` (blurry) instead of `-big-1.jpg` (HD).

minor.issue: The Deodap autosuggest cache holds shaped rows for 24h. When the `handle` field was newly added to _shape_deodap_row, all pre-existing cache entries continued to serve rows WITHOUT `handle` until they expired. On the fresh preview DB this caused my first test run to show 'no handle' for every Deodap row. After a manual `products_master_cache.delete_many({})` the field appeared correctly. Consider adding a schema-version key or one-shot purge on deploy so shape changes take effect immediately.

action_items: Fix /app/backend/routes/products_master.py:162 — change `if thumb and '/thumb/' in thumb and '-thumb-' in thumb:` to `if thumb and ('/thumb/' in thumb or '-thumb-' in thumb):` so the 91mobiles thumb→big rewrite actually triggers for the real URL format (`.../148763-v4-apple-iphone-15-mobile-phone-thumb-1.jpg`).

After the fix, purge products_master_cache: `db.products_master_cache.delete_many({})` so the newly-rewritten -big-1.jpg URLs replace the cached -thumb-1.jpg URLs immediately (24h cache would otherwise mask the fix).
Re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration37_deodap_detail.py — expected 11/11 after the AND→OR fix.
critical_code_review_comments: products_master.py:162 — the AND guard on the thumb→big rewrite is the root cause of the reported blurry-image bug; OR is required because 91mobiles CDN uses `-thumb-`/`-big-` suffix variants without any `/thumb/` path segment.

products_master.py cache — cache stores fully-shaped rows so any change to _shape_deodap_row or _shape_91_row is invisible until the cache expires (24h). Consider caching raw upstream JSON instead and re-shaping on read, or adding a `_shape_version` key.
products_master.py:400-416 — deodap_detail handler is clean: 400 for oversized handle, 404 for empty result. Good.
The `user: Dict = Depends(get_current_user)` on deodap_detail is intentionally unused (# noqa: F841). Fine, though a shorter `_ = Depends(...)` would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. TEST_iter37_* vendor product created and deleted in TestRegressionVendorImei via try/finally. products_master_cache was purged of 10 stale entries (safe, cache repopulates on next hit).

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/backend/routes/products_master.py:162 uses `if thumb and '/thumb/' in thumb and '-thumb-' in thumb:` (AND). Real 91mobiles autosuggest thumbnail URLs use only the `-thumb-N.jpg` suffix variant (no `/thumb/` path segment), e.g. `https://www.91-img.com/pictures/148763-v4-apple-iphone-15-mobile-phone-thumb-1.jpg`. The AND guard requires BOTH markers so the rewrite never runs and blurry thumbnails leak through. REPRO: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <alice>' '<BASE>/api/products/master/search?q=iphone+15&limit=15'` — every 91mobiles item has `image_url` ending in `-thumb-1.jpg`. MITIGATION: change AND to OR (single-word fix). After code fix, purge products_master_cache so the 24h-cached -thumb- rows are re-fetched and re-shaped as -big-. Verified end-to-end: replacing the URL manually to -big-1.jpg (e.g. `https://www.91-img.com/pictures/148763-v4-apple-iphone-15-mobile-phone-big-1.jpg`) does return an HD image.
